proposal.name: Say a person merges a retried plan in the trusted base

plan.name: Say a person merges a retried plan in the trusted base
plan.summary: When a writer comments `/invariant retry` on a plan whose pull request failed, the factory answers "Watching #N again. I'll merge it once CI's `invariant/gate` passes on its current head.", even when the pull request changes the trusted base, which only a person merges (D-0105). It said this on #100 about #117, and it's a promise the factory won't keep. Now, before it answers a retry of a plan's pull request, the factory reads what the pull request's branch changes in the trusted base, using the same scope check the watcher runs before a merge. If that's any file, the answer is "Watching #N again. It changes the trusted base (`file`, …), so once CI's `invariant/gate` passes on its current head, a person merges it.", naming the files as the build's own comment does. Every other retry, of a project's pull request or of a plan's that stays out of the trusted base, gets the same answer word for word as now, and nothing else changes: the post's marker and label, the protocol's step, and what the watcher does once the gate passes.

tests.name: TestARetriedPlanInTheTrustedBaseSaysAPersonMergesIt
tests.says: CI's gate fails on a plan's pull request that changes internal/factory/page.go, and a writer says retry. The answer never says the factory will merge it. It names the pull request, the trusted base and internal/factory/page.go, and says a person merges it once the gate passes.

tests.name: TestARetryPromisesAMergeOnlyWhenTheFactoryWillMakeIt
tests.says: A retried project pull request, and a retried plan pull request outside the trusted base, still get "Watching #N again. I'll merge it once CI's `invariant/gate` passes on its current head.", and each merges once the gate passes. A retried plan in the trusted base is promised no merge, and once the gate passes it waits for a person, unmerged.

usage.summary: The plan passed its first check. When someone retries a plan's failed pull request, the factory will check whether the branch changes the trusted base, the same way the watcher does before merging; if it does, the answer names those files and says a person merges it once CI's gate passes, and every other retry answer stays word for word as it is. Both acceptance tests in `internal/factory/retry_trusted_accept_test.go` fail on the current code, the build may only write `factory.go`, `plancomments.go` and `plumbing.go`, and since those are in the trusted base, a person merges the result.
